markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (92%)** · Confident · Careful review
Surgical frozen section with all four margins called positive [F7], severe stain degradation, and two invasive nearest neighbors.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 92%, Invasive 7%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% [F1] | InSitu favored; 7% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (10% alpha) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 90th percentile (12 tiles) [F6] | Passes QC despite degraded stain |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%) [F5] | Two closest neighbors are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score [F2] pushes toward invasive, but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical TIL score [F3]; descriptive only, 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Typical-level score [F4] lowers invasive probability; 19/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-average score slightly raises invasive probability; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score slightly lowers invasive probability; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score beyond random (0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 95% CI -0.009–0.006 spans 0); case leans on Unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20), `mitoses` (0/20), and `necrosis` (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 2 (92% risk) or 9 (75% risk) harbor focal invasion like nearest neighbor `BACH_0138` (88% similar, Invasive).
- Simulated frozen-section stain degradation (severity 3) distorts morphology or inflates all-margin positive calls (validation n=132, 24 patients).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 9**: Inspect highest-risk areas (92% and 75% invasive risk) for stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 4, 10, 11**: Confirm duct-confined atypia (4, 10) and disregard unreliable normal-lobule and necrosis concept scores (10, 11).
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at superior, inferior, medial, and lateral margins (108–538 um; stains blocked on frozen sections).
